eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Inyo, CA; at 11:58 AM on JUL 27, 2026 Effective until 11:58 AM JUL 28, 2026. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Tuesday, July 27, 2026 12:00 PM: This is a CONTINUATION OF AN EVACUATION WARNING in place for an active wildfire. Zones 123-B and 137-D have been downgraded to a warning. All prior warnings remain in effect.  The area affected are Big Pine Canyon/Fish Springs/Aberdean/Fort Independence. Unknown duration for warning. Prepare to evacuate due to an active wildfire. Residents with large animals and those requiring additional time should evacuate now.
